modules.module_title: Identify Types and Characteristics of Composite Materials

pcs.pc_description: Define composite materials and understand their role in aerospace engineering.
Identify different types of fibers (e.g., carbon, glass, aramid) used in aerospace composites.
Describe various resin/matrix materials (e.g., epoxy, polyester, phenolic) used in composite structures.
Distinguish between thermoset and thermoplastic composites and their applications.
Understand the concept of fiber orientation and lay-up patterns.
Identify common manufacturing methods (e.g., hand lay-up, vacuum bagging, RTM, filament winding).
Understand the curing process and the importance of temperature, pressure, and time control.
Recognize defects in composite manufacturing such as delamination, porosity, or fiber misalignment.

modules.module_title: Know Applications and Limitations of Composites

pcs.pc_description: Identify key aerospace components made from composite materials (e.g., fuselage panels, fairings, control surfaces).
Understand the advantages of composites (e.g., high strength-to-weight ratio, corrosion resistance).
Understand the limitations and challenges, including repair complexity and material sensitivity.

modules.module_title: Hand layup of composite parts and bagging

pcs.pc_description: interpret and gather components drawings, route book, lay up sequence/ sketch for establishing the process control and development controls
ensure the prepeg material should be kept for the required hours at room temperature before use
ensure availability of required materials like prepregs, adhesives, cores, sheet metal details etc. required to start part/assembly fabrication

ensure start lay-up of part as per the layup sequence/ sketch, refer to drawings where required and ensures correctness of material and orientation. Lay-up of travel coupon panels (TC panels) as required and the route book
lay-up (monolithic or sandwich) as per approved drawings/ process sheet
place the thermocouple between the tool surface after completion of lay-up, and lay-up to monitor the temperature during curing
ensure the right bagging film, release film, breather and the sealant are used for bagging; check the shelf life of these materials with the supervisor
prepare vacuum bag and seal the lay-up with vacuum bag, provide the vacuum valves
carry out vacuum leak check, vacuum leak shall be within permissible limits
trim the parts and de-burr as per the drawings.
maintain a clean and safe working environment near the trimming place to avoid contaminated oil/ moisture absorption.
prepare test specimens to the correct dimensions as per the standards/ work instructions.

pcs.pc_description: interpret and understand the layup sequence mentioned in the drawing/ route card/ process sheet
collect all the required tools from stores

prepare the prepregs material for moulding and store in the laying up machine
ensure that the layup sequence is adhered as per drawings/ process sheet
maintain the required gap between layup rollers and the bench

roll the rollers such that there is continuity in laying up the prepreg material or fix up the ends of the fibre on the machine and fix up on the surface. Ensure procedure/ laying instructions as per the laying up machine are followed

trim the excess material using the cutters on the machine
finish the edges as per procedures provided in the drawing
maintain a clean and safe working environment near the machine to avoid contaminated oil/ moisture absorption
prepare the test specimens to the correct dimensions as per the standards/ work instructions
offer parts and specimen to Quality department for inspection
